entries.applies_to: Transient lodging guest rooms with mobility features

source.title: 2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design

entries.note: Each clear floor space complies with 305 (30 x 48 in, 760 x 1220 mm; see routes.us.ada.clear_floor_space.*), positioned for a parallel approach to the side of the bed. Exception: one such space between two beds is enough (no space needed on both sides of a bed).
